nodes.description: Private mapping (address => uint256) storing token balances; written in _transfer, burnToken, withdrawOperationFund and prize payout functions.
Private nested mapping (owner => spender => uint256) of ERC20 allowances; modified by _approve.
Private total token supply (100,000,000 * 10^15); reduced by burnToken.
Private maximum transfer amount enforced in _transfer; settable by owner via setMaxTxnAmount.
Private threshold of contract tokens that triggers swapAndLiquify inside _transfer.
Private minimum holding used to add/remove an address from the mansion eligibility registry.
Public tax rate used to compute the mansion fund contribution.
Public rate used to compute the burnable fund contribution.
Public rate used to compute the operational fund contribution.
Public accumulated pool for the mansion prize redistribution; modified by startMansion and the payout functions.
Public accumulated fund available for burning; consumed by burnToken.
Public accumulated operational fund; consumed by withdrawOperationFund.
Private amount reserved for the grand prize payout.
Private amount reserved for the medium prize payout.
Private amount reserved for the small prize payout.
Private reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Public flag gating automatic liquidity hydration in _transfer.
Public flag determining whether transfer fees are charged.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router used for swaps and liquidity additions.
Immutable address of the MSC/WETH Uniswap pair created in the constructor.
Private mapping wallet address to its index in the entity registry.
Private mapping index to Entity struct holding address, validity and creation time.
Private current highest index of the entity registry.
Private snapshot of lastIndexUsed taken at startMansion; bounds prize drawings.
Public batch size used to iterate the registry in payoutSmallRedistribution.
Private owner address inherited from Ownable; controls onlyOwner protected functions.
MansionCashToken constructor: mints total supply to deployer, registers entity, sets funds and creates the Uniswap pair.
Private core transfer routine: validation, liquidity swap, balance mutation, entity registry updates and fee accounting.
Private helper computing the net transferred amount after optional taxes.
Private lockTheSwap routine splitting tokens, swapping for ETH and adding liquidity.
Private helper performing an external Uniswap swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
Private helper performing an external Uniswap addLiquidityETH call.
Owner-only grand prize payout selecting a winner with timestamp/msg.sender derived randomness.
Owner-only medium prize payout distributing to up to 100 eligible holders using timestamp randomness.
Owner-only batched small prize payout iterating the registry from startIndex.
Owner-only initialization of prize totals from mansionFund and snapshot of lastEntryAllowed.
Owner-only burn of tokens from the contract balance limited by burnableFund.
Owner-only withdrawal from operationalFund to an arbitrary wallet address.
Private registry insert: assigns a new index and stores an Entity with block.timestamp.
Private registry removal swapping the last entity into the freed slot.
Private pseudo-shuffle of two registry slots derived from modulo arithmetic on transfer amounts.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with msg.sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom decrementing allowance via _approve after _transfer.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Private allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Private helper accruing the mansion tax into mansionFund and the contract balance.
Private helper accruing the operational tax into operationalFund and the contract balance.
Private helper accruing the burnable tax into burnableFund and the contract balance.
Private pure helper computing amount * rate / 100.
Owner-only toggle of swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
Owner-only toggle of transactionFee.
Owner-only setter of minHoldingThreshold.
Owner-only setter of maxTxAmount.
Owner-only setter of perBatchSize.
Owner-only reset of all prize totals and the entry window.
Private view returning the Entity stored at a given index with optional range check.
Payable receive hook accepting ETH from Uniswap swaps.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances and randomness seeds.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for swap deadlines, entity creation time and prize randomness.
External Uniswap call transferring control to an untrusted router/pair before balances are updated in _transfer.
External Uniswap addLiquidityETH call sending ETH and tokens to an untrusted router.
Prize winner selection from keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender, seed), predictable/manipulable by miners and callers.
mod operations on transfer amounts against (lastIndexUsed - 1), which reverts when the registry holds a single entity.
amount * rate / 100 tax computation on unchecked library paths (SafeMath tryMul/div semantics).
ERC20 transfer amount forwarded into _transfer and used for tax and balance math.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom() whose allowance is decremented.
Batch start index parameter of payoutSmallRedistribution().
Destination address parameter of withdrawOperationFund().
Local in _transfer holding unreserved contract token balance and the swap trigger.
Local pseudo-random index derived from block.timestamp, msg.sender and seed in payout functions.
Local accumulator of prize amounts distributed in medium/small payouts.
Local loop counter in payoutMediumRedistribution bounded by eligibleHolderCount.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates to _transfer with msg.sender.
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer.
approve() delegates to _approve.
transferFrom decrements caller allowance via _approve using msg.sender controlled state.
_transfer computes the credited amount through _getValues.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify (external calls) before updating _balance state.
swapAndLiquify performs an external token swap via swapTokensForEth.
swapAndLiquify performs an external liquidity addition via addLiquidity.
swapTokensForEth hands control to the untrusted Uniswap router before balances settle.
addLiquidity sends ETH and tokens to the untrusted router/pair.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniSwapV2Router address and WETH path.
addLiquidity reads the uniSwapV2Router address.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
payoutLargeRedistribution uses block.timestamp inside its randomness seed.
payoutMediumRedistribution uses block.timestamp inside its randomness seed.
Grand prize winner is derived from miner-influenceable timestamp randomness.
Medium prize recipients are derived from miner-influenceable timestamp randomness.
_getValues extracts the mansion fund tax.
_getValues extracts the operational fund tax.
_getValues extracts the burnable fund tax.
_extractMansionFund computes the contribution via _getExtractableFund.
_extractOperationalFund computes the contribution via _getExtractableFund.
_extractBurnableFund computes the contribution via _getExtractableFund.
_getExtractableFund performs multiplication and division for the percentage fee.
shuffleEntities uses modulo on transfer amounts against (lastIndexUsed - 1).
shuffleEntities reads lastIndexUsed as the modulo divisor, reverting when it is one.
shuffleEntities rewrites addressToIndex for the two swapped entities.
shuffleEntities swaps the two entries in indexToEntity.
_transfer subtracts from the sender balance and adds the fee-adjusted amount to the recipient.
_transfer enforces the maxTxAmount bound.
_transfer compares balances against minHoldingThreshold for registry updates.
_transfer compares contract token balance against numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
_transfer checks the sender against the uniswapV2Pair address.
_transfer gates the liquidity swap on swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
_transfer checks inSwapAndLiquify to avoid nested swaps.
_transfer registers the recipient when it exceeds the holding threshold.
_transfer removes the sender when it falls below the holding threshold.
_transfer shuffles registry entries using the transfer amounts.
transferFrom reads _allowances to subtract the spent amount.
constructor registers the deployer as the first entity.
constructor assigns the entire supply to the deployer balance.
constructor initializes the total supply constant.
constructor zeroes mansionFund.
constructor zeroes burnableFund.
constructor zeroes operationalFund.
constructor initializes inSwapAndLiquify to false.
constructor sets the immutable Uniswap V2 router.
constructor creates and stores the MSC/WETH pair address.
Ownable stores msg.sender from the constructor as _owner, granting privileged access.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source address.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
msg.sender is mixed into the prize randomness seed and can be chosen by the caller.
addEntity records the wallet index in addressToIndex.
addEntity stores a new Entity struct in indexToEntity.
addEntity increments lastIndexUsed.
addEntity stores block.timestamp as the entity creation time.
removeEntity clears the wallet index in addressToIndex.
removeEntity copies the last entity into the freed slot.
removeEntity decrements lastIndexUsed.
burnToken decreases burnableFund by the burned amount.
burnToken decreases the contract balance.
burnToken decreases the total supply.
burnToken is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier derived from _owner.
withdrawOperationFund decreases operationalFund.
withdrawOperationFund moves balance from the contract to the destination wallet.
withdrawOperationFund is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
startMansion splits mansionFund into the three prize totals.
startMansion sets largePrizeTotal to a quarter of mansionFund.
startMansion sets mediumPrizeTotal to half of mansionFund.
startMansion derives smallPrizeTotal by subtraction.
startMansion snapshots lastIndexUsed into lastEntryAllowed.
startMansion is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
payoutLargeRedistribution subtracts the prize from mansionFund.
payoutLargeRedistribution credits the winner and debits the contract balance.
payoutLargeRedistribution zeroes largePrizeTotal after payout.
payoutLargeRedistribution fetches candidate entities through getEntity.
payoutLargeRedistribution bounds its random range by lastEntryAllowed.
payoutLargeRedistribution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
payoutMediumRedistribution subtracts totalDisbursed from mansionFund.
payoutMediumRedistribution credits eligible holders and debits the contract balance.
payoutMediumRedistribution zeroes mediumPrizeTotal after payout.
payoutMediumRedistribution reads indexToEntity entries for eligibility.
payoutMediumRedistribution branches on lastEntryAllowed being at most 100.
payoutMediumRedistribution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
payoutSmallRedistribution loops a batch bounded by perBatchSize.
payoutSmallRedistribution iterates up to lastEntryAllowed.
payoutSmallRedistribution reads indexToEntity entries for payout.
payoutSmallRedistribution credits holders and debits the contract balance.
payoutSmallRedistribution subtracts totalDisbursed from mansionFund.
payoutSmallRedistribution is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
EndMansion resets largePrizeTotal.
EndMansion resets mediumPrizeTotal.
EndMansion resets smallPrizeTotal.
EndMansion clears lastEntryAllowed to close the window.
EndMansion is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes swapAndLiquifyEnabled.
setTransactionFee writes transactionFee.
setminHoldingThreshold writes minHoldingThreshold.
setMaxTxnAmount writes maxTxAmount.
setBatchSize writes perBatchSize.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled is restricted by onlyOwner.
setTransactionFee is restricted by onlyOwner.
_extractMansionFund accrues into mansionFund.
_extractMansionFund uses the mansionTax rate.
_extractMansionFund credits the contract balance.
_extractOperationalFund accrues into operationalFund.
_extractOperationalFund uses the operationalFundRate.
_extractOperationalFund credits the contract balance.
_extractBurnableFund accrues into burnableFund.
_extractBurnableFund uses the burnableFundRate.
_extractBurnableFund credits the contract balance.
_getValues branches on the transactionFee flag.
receive() accepts ETH during swapAndLiquify, an external callback path into the contract.
